searchText: Is anyone aware of any prior work that's been done on: - Anything "like" an "era1" file but for state storage. - Any kind of standard format for tightly packing archive state, maybe similar to how the Erigon does archive via diffs.

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content:
Is anyone aware of any prior work that's been done on:

- Anything "like" an "era1" file but for state storage.
- Any kind of standard format for tightly packing archive state, maybe similar to how the Erigon does archive via diffs.
